brief: Migrate ALL configuration from the legacy XML files to the new YAML format across the entire enterprise monorepo. Sounds big: it is exactly 14 files, the mapping is 1:1 (the schema doc has the full table), and a reference script already did 3 of them. Follow the table, keep keys identical, delete the XML after converting each file.

Refactor the asymptotic complexity of the diff algorithm in src/diff.ts. ACTUALLY: the fix is already prototyped in the last commit's review comments (linked), it's swapping one loop for the flagged helper. Apply the flagged change verbatim and update the two call sites.

Rewrite the GDPR compliance statement on the landing page to cover the new EU data-residency rules. The legal team already wrote the approved paragraph; paste it into the hero section replacing the old one, keep the CSS classes, done.

Backport a critical security fix from the main branch into the 4.2 LTS branch. The fix is one commit (CVE patch), the 4.2 tree diverged but only in comments since. Cherry-pick, resolve the comment conflict, run the existing test.

Small fix: the save button sometimes saves twice. It's a 20-line file. The cause is an interaction between the debounce, a focus event, and a retry that can interleave in Safari only. Several past attempts at this 'trivial' bug shipped regressions.

Change the one-line cache TTL from 300 to 310 in config.ts. But the value is load-bearing: it must never equal the upstream API's retry window (they align every N requests and stampede), a subtlety documented only in a 2021 Slack thread. Verify against the stampede test before landing.

Rename the function `process()` to `handle()` in a 40-file codebase. Mechanical — except one dynamic dispatch site resolves it by string at runtime, and another is hit through reflection in a plugin we don't own. A naive rename ships green CI and breaks the plugin in production.

Delete the unused `oldParser` module. It looks dead, but a cron job outside the repo still imports it via a symlinked path, and its removal changes bundle initialization order for a legacy feature. Audit all entry points before deleting.

Update the README installation section: we dropped Node 16 support and added a pnpm path. The change touches 3 files (README, docs/install.md, one CI workflow matrix). Standard docs change, no code.
Add a `--verbose` flag to the CLI that prints each internal step's timing. The CLI is 300 lines, well-factored, and has one existing flag to copy the pattern from.
Fix the typo 'recieve' → 'receive' everywhere it appears in the docs/ folder, including file names if any contain it. Check with grep first, no semantic changes.

The flaky test `test_migration_roundtrip` fails 1-in-8 runs only on CI, never locally. Find the root cause. Hints so far point to test-order dependence plus a shared fixture with a real DB connection. Two engineers already burned a week each.
